newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal spreads vs Bunds, Bonos.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal spreads vs Bunds, Bonos.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of five banks.
Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

- 10-year bonds seen trading quietly but could face volatility after the first round of French legislative elections. Market focused on five-year fixed rate bond auction, which expected to show an average weighted interest rate around 5.80 percent. Dealers expect shorter bonds to be well-supported.
Note: YLDS3 is still calculated on basis of Feb 06 bond.
